Every item is one unit, and so one **token**: `a,b,1` has the `RawText` tokens
`

judgment.note: Every item is one unit and one token, but a field cut into two touching tokens of its kind is not reported: in sankey/db-text-with-spaces, cutting the `RawText` token `a b` at [7,10] into `a` and ` b`, which touch, gives no problem, since the value of the SankeyIdentifier is still the texts of its tokens joined. The same miss is recorded for the `RawText` row of tokens.md. The other cases are reported: a line feed as a token (check-tree-shared-tokens.test.ts, "fails the line feed after a sankey record as a token"), an unquoted id as an `Identifier` token ("fails an unquoted sankey id as an Identifier token"), and an unquoted value as a `Numeric` token ("fails an unquoted sankey value as a Numeric token").
